name: create_lesson
description: Create a new lesson with specified lesson sections

primaryColor.description: The primary color of the lesson given in hexadecimal.

faIcon.description: The icon to display, this should be without the fa-prefix, so to choose the icon faBook, book needs to be given.

code.description: The lesson code, to organize lessons of a course.

sections.description: List of sections in the lesson, each of type html, interactive module, or question

content.description: Content for an HTML section; required if type is html

position.description: The position of the lesson section

questionPrompt.description: Question text; required if type is question

questionType.description: Possible answers for the question; required if type is question

optionText.description: The option text to be displayed as option

position.description: The position of the option relative to the other options.

questionExplanation.description: The text that displays after a given answer to further explain the right answer.

correct_answer.description: Correct answer for the question; required if type is question
